title: Physics & Collision
description: Configure solid terrain, angled slopes, capsule colliders, trigger zones, and combat hitboxes in Lupis Engine.

blocks.content: Lupis Engine separates physical blocking collisions from non-blocking overlap detection so you can build smooth terrain traversal and responsive combat on the same [entity](components/entities_and_prefabs). Combine [Physics Body](components/physics_body) and [Multi-Collider](components/multi_collider) with the nodes in [Physics & Collision](node_library/game_physics) and [Helper & Tool](node_library/helper_tool).

blocks.message: Press **Esc** in the [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport) and enable the collider bound toggles under **Quick Actions** in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector) to visualize solid, trigger, hitbox, and hurtbox wireframes while editing.

rows: You want characters to walk smoothly over tile seams, climb angled ramps, and align to sloped terrain.
You want to build collectible pickups, hazard zones, checkpoints, and melee hitbox-to-hurtbox combat.
You want to reference all Physics Body properties and body types.
You want to attach multiple collider shapes to a single entity.
You want to set up platformer, top-down, or AI patrol controllers.
